messages:
nina_cs: Quick summary from this week's onboarding calls — collated 7 sessions, recurring asks below. TL;DR: 4 actionable items.

nina_cs: 1) Onboarding checklist gaps — customers getting stuck on per-route billing toggle & console flows.
nina_cs: 2) Embeddings latency variance on Dedicated — p95 spikes causing fuzzy search mismatches.
nina_cs: 3) Intermittent 429s on large file uploads during onboarding.
nina_cs: 4) Customers asking for per-account usage dashboards for renewals.

cal_pm: tagging @maya_pm @omar_eng — which of these tie to roadmap work? prioritization please.
omar_eng: embeddings latency sounds infra/serving. can you paste a concrete trace sample (route + p95 + model)?
nina_cs: sure — pasted example below from Glacier pilot: 
``
customer: GlacierAnalytics
route: product_search
p95_embedding_latency: 820ms
model: redwood-embed-v1-quant
host: ded-gpu-04
```
maya_pm: thanks. my thinking: dashboards = highest priority for renewals, then onboarding checklist copy fixes, then engineering perf work (embeddings batching). docs/ops 429 is also high because it blocks onboarding flows.
sam_se: +1 on dashboards. Renewal risk flagged for GlacierAnalytics, HelixCardio, NorthBay — they asked explicitly.
helena_support: i dug into the 429s — looks like multipart timeout at nginx layer when they upload >50MB. raised to #eng-infra.

nina_cs: Glacier asked for a one-page checklist + short curl examples they can hand to engineers. willing to pilot a checklist with them next week.
liam_devex: I can draft a 1-page checklist + console screenshots. estimate: 2d draft + 1d review.
omar_eng: engineering action — we need a telemetry query for embedding p95 by route and host. owner: omar_eng. i'll produce a query and share.
cal_pm: proposed action items — please ack owners: 
1) liam_devex -> checklist draft (2d)
2) omar_eng -> telemetry query for embedding p95 by route (EOD)
3) maya_pm/docs -> per-route billing doc updates (owner: maya_pm)
4) nina_cs -> pilot checklist with Glacier and attach quotes (next week)

nina_cs: will create Linear cards and attach customer quotes.
maya_pm: can CS paste 1-2 verbatim customer lines in the ticket — they help prioritize.
nina_cs: added three short quotes to the ticket. sample: "We couldn't tell which toggle controls token billing per route — cost surprised us during trial."
liam_devex: for the checklist i need 2 screenshots and one curl snippet. @nina_cs can you collect those?
nina_cs: on it. will add to the Linear card.
omar_eng: shares debugging query by EOD — will include host-level breakdown so we can see if ded-gpu-04 is an outlier.
ops-bot: nginx timeout increase patch scheduled for deploy: 2024-11-06T02:00:00Z to address multipart timeouts (inc. 429s).
helena_support: after deploy i'll monitor and loop back.
cal_pm: thanks team. any blockers to start these tickets?
maya_pm: none from PM.
liam_devex: none — will start draft tomorrow.
nina_cs: no blockers. i'll coordinate pilot dates with Glacier's CSM. thanks all :thumbsup:
cal_pm: great sync — i'll convert this thread into the weekly CS->product digest. closing here.
